blueprints.structural_header_spec: 300mm reinforced Class-4 concrete with lead-bismuth sandwich doors
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Decontamination nozzle valve seizure; toxic aerosol backdraft into corridor
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: The lead sandwich door weighs three tons. If the counterweight cable shears, it drops like a guillotine. Never stand under the threshold while operating the manual winch.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Acoustically isolated foundation block resting on neoprene elastomer pads
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Crankcase over-pressurization explosion; diesel fuel line fire; carbon monoxide flood
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Acoustic insulation is perforated steel over rockwool. Even with earplugs, your teeth vibrate at 1500 RPM. Check the oil level twice per watch.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Dual HEPA filter banks with activated coconut shell charcoal beds
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Blower impeller bearing seizure; radioactive particulate breakthrough into residential ducts
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: The charcoal beds must be baked out with steam every three months. When replacing the pre-filters, the technician must wear full hazmat.

blueprints.room_name: Deep Artesian Well & Water Pump Station
blueprints.structural_header_spec: Cased borehole to -120m into unconfined dolomite aquifer with multistage turbine pump
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Submersible pump motor burnout; borehole casing collapse; aquifer brine intrusion
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: The purest water in the province. 4°C straight out of the dolomite. Keep the check valves greased with food-grade silicone.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Double-tiered pine plank bunks with felt curtain baffles and personal footlockers
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Thermal duct blockage leading to hypothermia cluster; infectious outbreak in tight quarters
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Sixteen dwellers in fifty square meters. Keep personal lockers locked to prevent theft drama. Wool curtains cut the corridor whispers.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Cast-iron three-kettle coal-fired range with direct flue bypass to exhaust shaft
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Flue grease fire; steam pressure relief valve explosion; spoiled batch poisoning
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: The heart of the shelter. If the kettle is hot and smells of rye and salt pork, morale stays above forty. Never extinguish the hearth fire.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Cascading timber peat troughs with full-spectrum fluorescent and LED lighting banks
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Nutrient pump failure leading to total crop root dry-out within 18 hours; whitefly blight
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Elena's domain. The lighting ballast heat helps warm the residential level above. Use diluted bone ash broth for root phosphorus.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Lead-lined operating alcove with pressurized positive-air filtration and stainless table
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Loss of sterilizing autoclave pressure; cross-contamination in surgical field
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: The quietest room in the complex. Keep the temperature at 22°C for surgical shock recovery. Dr. Vel's instruments must never rust.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: 3-phase 380V busbars powering screw-cutting lathe, vertical mill, and shaping planer
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Flywheel shatter; lathe chuck ejection; tool steel fracture during heavy pass
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: If Oleg is turning steel, the bunker can replace any broken gear or valve. Keep the cutting oil reservoir filtered and free of metal swarf.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Faraday cage copper mesh enclosure with coaxial lead-in to surface longwire mast
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Lightning or EMP surge strike destroying vacuum tube RF front-end; mast guy wire snapping
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Keep transmission power under fifty watts so The Keeper doesn't target the mast. Taras knows how to tune the 807 tube with his eyes closed.

blueprints.room_name: The Silent Foundry Blast Furnace & Casting Bay
blueprints.structural_header_spec: Refractory firebrick cupola furnace with water-jacketed tuyeres and sand casting beds
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Molten iron breakout through hearth brick; water-slag steam vapor explosion
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Pours five hundred kilos of grey iron per heat. The heat radiates through two floor levels. Stokers must wear cobalt glass goggles.

blueprints.room_name: Main DC Battery Storage & Inverter Vault
blueprints.structural_header_spec: Acid-resistant rubber-lined concrete benches holding 120 glass stationary cells
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Hydrogen gas accumulation leading to spark ignition; cell jar thermal runaway
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Continuous forced exhaust is mandatory to vent hydrogen during charging. Specific gravity must be measured daily with the hydrometer.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Multi-stage flash evaporator coupled with zeolite and silver-impregnated ceramic filters
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Boiler scale calcification clogging tubes; membrane fouling resulting in saline breakthrough
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Desalinates canal brine into crystal clean drinking water. Recover the dry mineral salt cake for curing meat and bread seasoning.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Spark-proof brass tool benches, conductive bronze floor ground, and blowout blast vent
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Nitrocellulose powder detonation; primer friction ignition destroying armory wing
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Zero iron tools allowed. Brass spoons, lead weights, wooden tampers only. Stepan inspects every reloaded 7.62mm casing with a micrometer.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Polished blue slate wall slabs with deep chiselled inscriptions in natural limestone vault
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Strata spalling causing slab fracture; moisture seepage eroding engraved records
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Sister Mara's sanctuary. Every dweller who died in the thirty years is carved here in stone. Cool, dry, absolute silence. A place to remember.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Treadle-powered wooden shuttle looms with vulcanizing iron for rubberized protective gear
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Vulcanizing iron overheating rubber cement; lint dust flash flare
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Master Grigory produces double-knit wool socks, coats, and patches for the surface suits. Without good wool, we would have buried thirty more scouts.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Borosilicate distillation glass train with lead fume hood and ceramic drain trough
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Nitric acid vapor blowout; organic solvent fire; toxic fume migration into airlocks
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Ilya's lab. Refines sulfur, synthesizes battery acid, assays iron ore samples, and extracts botanical tinctures. Keep the exhaust blower energized at all times.

blueprints.room_name: Hermetic Grain Silo & Dry Stores Magazine
blueprints.structural_header_spec: Hermetically sealed steel bins under dry nitrogen blanket to prevent weevil growth
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Grain dust deflagration; condensation causing Aspergillus mold spoilage of whole silo
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: The survival balance sheet. Harlan weighs every gram here. Relative humidity must stay below twelve percent, or forty tons of durum wheat becomes poison.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Circular saw bench and mortising rig for cutting 200mm square pine mine drift sets
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Saw blade kickback; sawdust accumulation fire hazard in timber storage racks
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Mikhail's wood shop. Crafts the timber square sets that keep thirty thousand tons of shale from crushing our living quarters. Smells wonderfully of fresh pine sap.

blueprints.room_name: Vertical Bunker Armor & Harpoon Deflector Strata
blueprints.structural_header_spec: Alternating strata of granite boulders, slag gravel, and 100mm manganese steel deflector plates
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Direct kinetic tungsten penetrator breach piercing upper three residential tiers
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Installed to defeat Harrow orbital penetrators. Five meters of slag gravel dissipates kinetic shockwaves before they reach the limestone roof.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Charred oak casks sealed with beeswax and lead foil for secondary fermentation
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: CO2 gas accumulation asphyxiating cellar tender; sour lactobacillus contamination
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Boris brews fifty liters of dark winter porter every fortnight. Vitamin B, calories, and laughter. A lighted candle must be carried into the cellar at all times to test for CO2.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Amber glass reagent bottles, brass analytical balance, and hydraulic herb press
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Accidental tincture mislabeling causing belladonna poisoning; mold growth on drying herbs
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Where Elena and Sonya turn willow bark, garlic bulbs, and pine needles into life-saving medicines. Always keep the balance calibrated with the 1-gram nickel weight.

blueprints.structural_header_spec: Slate blackboard, tiered pine benches, and the Forty Articles Constitution Podium
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Acoustic echoing preventing debate; emotional factional brawl in crowded chamber
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: In the morning, Sonya teaches arithmetic and botany to twenty children. In the evening, the valley council votes on food rations and treaties. The crucible of the future.

blueprints.room_name: The Sunken Atrium of Sonya's Tree
blueprints.structural_header_spec: Retractable quartz double-glazed skylight admitting natural sunlight to open mountain soil
blueprints.catastrophic_failure_mode: Skylight glass fracture during hailstorm; frost damage to apple blossom canopy
blueprints.chief_engineer_note: Built on Day 3650. The skylight rolls open on bronze tracks. Real sunlight falls on Sonya's apple tree. Dwellers sit under green leaves and smell the spring air. We built a home.
